The prepared precursor solution was spin-coated at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s onto the substrate. In the last 10 s of the second step, the anti-solvent (120 µL of chlorobenzene) was dropped in the center at a constant rate The substrates were sequentially heated at 110 °C for 30 min for perovskite crystal formation.
